title: Dependencies: known vulnerabilities, updates and version pinning

videos.script: You installed two packages in lesson one. Pip installed twelve. {{twelve}} Most of the code in a Python application was written by somebody else. And it runs with the same rights as yours. {{rights}} When a flaw is found in one of those packages, it gets published, with the version that fixes it. {{published}} From that day, anybody can look it up. You included. {{lookup}} A tool called pip-audit does the looking for you. Give it your list of versions, and it names what needs to move. {{audit}} Today you audit a lock file from last year, raise two pins, and audit it again. Then you set up the habit that keeps it clean. {{habit}}
